study type: Observational study with a preintervention and postintervention design
outcome: 30-day surgical site infection rate after cesarean delivery
cohort: 2576 women undergoing cesarean delivery at a tertiary care hospital between January 1, 2013 and December 31, 2017
finding: Implementation of a comprehensive, multidisciplinary bundle of evidence-based interventions was associated with a significant reduction in 30-day surgical site infection rates after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Implementation of an evidence-based bundle of interventions led to a significant reduction in 30-day surgical site infections after cesarean delivery.
